race.description: Watson Mcnamara & Watt Guyra Cup Hcp
race.comment: SHAMEDY (2) will find this exactly his right journey. He goes all his best over this and handles any type of going. He rarely runs you a bad race and as long as he gets a decent run, he has to be in the finish. Has won here before too. INDIFFERENCE (1) does get an important claim for this. He simply gave away too much start at Scone. Second up is generally a better spot for him. A softer track won't hurt either. GHOST WALKER (5) draws inside so won't be having to do any work early. He is another who works into his preparations. Can run you a race. ZAMBORGHINI (7) tends to mix his form but improved last start to finish third over 1600m at Scone. In the mix.
